title: Namespace paths on channels
description:
As a member, I want each session to have a hierarchical path (/, /ops/deploy), so that sessions are organized and addressable.

Feature: Session paths
  Scenario: A channel has a unique path within its tenant
    Given a channel at /ops/deploy
    When another channel in the same tenant is given /ops/deploy
    Then it is rejected

See docs/SESSION_NAMESPACE.md.
right_now_summary: The team is defining unique hierarchical paths for channels within each tenant.
